name: github-plan-wiki
description: Break an approved plan into a parent GitHub issue plus sub-issues, and publish feature/refactor/perf plans to the repository's GitHub wiki in English and Japanese.

interface.longDescription: Turns an approved plan into a GitHub issue hierarchy (one parent issue plus sub-issues, never flat unrelated issues) using the gh CLI's native sub-issue support, then publishes feature/refactor/perf plans to the repository's GitHub wiki as bilingual English/Japanese pages with a maintained, grouped Home index.
defaultPrompt: Break this approved plan into a parent issue and sub-issues with $github-plan-issues.
Publish this approved plan to the GitHub wiki with $github-wiki-plan.
